title: World's Largest Swim Lesson!
description:
What a fun pool day! 🏊 

Last week, San Diego youth participated in the World’s Largest Swim Lesson at the Dr. Martin Luther King Swimming Pool. This global event helps communities build awareness about drowning prevention and the importance of teaching children to swim. 

The event also included a special water safety and drowning prevention proclamation with Councilmember Henry L. Foster III , Prevent Drowning Foundation of San Diego, American Red Cross Southern California Region, and the Independent Pool and Spa Service Association. 

Whether you're at the pool or the beach this summer, practicing water safety can help save lives. The City offers free, year-round swimming lessons emphasizing skill progression, water safety awareness and endurance.  

Learn more about swimming lessons and water safety tips🛟: sandiego.gov/pools/programs/swim-program
